notes: v14 SAB SE BARI UPDATE (v11-requirements ki takmeel): (1) ADMIN KI AWAAZ — Settings mein 'Admin ki Awaaz' se apni awaaz save karein (5 jumle); us ke baad HUKAM sirf admin ki awaaz par chalega, guftagu sab ke liye khuli. Awaaz na mile ya mashkook ho to PIN/fingerprint ka rasta hamesha khula hai — aap kabhi lock nahi honge. NOTE: awaaz ki pehchan pehle din se perfect nahi hoti; asli awaaz par istemal ke saath behtar hogi. Aur pakki baat: awaaz ki RECORDING kabhi save nahi hoti — sirf profile ke numbers save hote hain. (2) AVATAR — ab screen ke UPAR BEECH mein ek hi jagah ata hai, peeche bilkul saaf (koi plate/panel nahi, aap ki screen dikhti rehti hai), saath mein likhi hui halat; kaam ke dauran thora bara, 15 second khamoshi par khud ghayeb. Chhota hamesha-wala avatar khatam. (3) MIC HANDOVER — koi doosri app mic istemal kare to Dost khud peeche hat jata hai, mic free hote hi khud wapas sunna shuru kar deta hai. (4) Ek ghalat andaza reject ho jaye to Dost wahi dobara nahi poochta. (5) API key wale khane mein ab EK hi line mein poori baat: Bara Dimagh tayyar hai, ya kya baaki hai.
